tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lo rgyus rgyal ba g.yung gis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku zhi khro'i tshogs/ /sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen dgongs pa brgyud/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /shrī sing ha o rgyan yab yum dang*/ /chos kyi rgyal po rang byung rdo rje la/ /bdag cag gang zag gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'dir theg pa thams cad kyi yangs rtse/ man ngag thams cad gyi nying khu/ mngon sum rang thog tu gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnad/ zab pa las ches zab pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi snying khrag gcig tu dril ba mkha' 'gro snying thig ces bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag khyad par can gyi chos 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ mkha' klong rnam par dag pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum chos kyi sku dri ma dang bral ba/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa las/ sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs nas/ chos sku spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas 'og min gyi gnas su dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la rang bzhin gyi byin gyis rlabs kyis bshad do/ /longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du/ bzhugs pa de mi'i yul du bzhugs kyang dgongs pa sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa'i sprul pa po dga' rab rdo rje la tshig tsam du bshad/ des slob dpon shrī sing ha la rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod chen por mngon sum rang thog tu phab nas bstan/ des rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal zhes bya ba rdo rje lta bu'i sku 'das grongs dang bral ba de la dur khrod chen po so sa'i gling du gnas lugs yid dpyod dang bral bar bstan/ de yang kun tu bzang mo klong gsal nyi ma'i rgyud dang*/ rig pa rang shar gyi rgyud dang*/ snying gi me long gi rgyud/ yi ge med pa'i rgyud/ sgrol ma 'bar ba'i rgyud/ nor bu phra bkod kyi rgyud/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud/

ngo sprod spras pa'i rgyud/ mu tig phreng ba'i rgyud/ rig pa rang grol gyi rgyud/ rdzogs pa rang byung gi rgyud/ klong chen drug pa'i rgyud/ sku gdung 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud dang bcu bdun dang*/ gzhan yang stong gsal dri med rgyud/ gcig shes kun grol gyi rgyud/ yang ti gser 'bru gcig pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rgyud/ rang byung rig pa'i rgyud/ yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud/ de ltar btags pas grol ba'i rgyud drug /sangs rgyas dang rig 'dzin gyi 'das rjes/ btags grol snying po'i don khrid dang bcas pa rnams gtad nas mngon sum rang thog tu gtan la phab bo/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma byung gnas kyis g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu gnang ba bzhin mngon du gyur nas rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyi rabs kyi don du man ngag tu bkod pa 'di rnams ni/ dbang po tha ma'i rten gyi gang zag kyang lo bdun dang zla ba bcu gcig la phung po lhag ma med par 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon chen po de 'pho ba chen po'i lus kyis bod yul du byon nas/ lha srin gdug pa can thams cad btul zhing dam la btags/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la sogs pa las can gyi slob ma dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du thugs gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas yod kyi/ rdzogs pa chen po snying tig gi gdul bya rnams bi ma la mi tra byon nas 'dul bar dgongs te dar bar ma mdzad do/ /gzho stod ti sgro'i brag la bzhugs pa'i dus su jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis zhabs tog bgyis shing dbang dang gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs shing yi ger btab nas gu ru la zhus pa/ chos 'di rnams spel lam sbed/ gdul bya la phan ji ltar thogs gang gis spyod zhus pas/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab gter du sbed dgos/

mnga' bdag gi sras mo lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyis snying tig gi dpe sgrom spyi bor blangs nas smon lam btab pas mo'i chos skal yin/ mo tshe'i dus byas nas skye ba 'ga' zhig brgyud pa'i tha ma la chos 'di dang 'phrad/ de'i phyir sbed dgos/ snying tig gi bstan pa bi ma las skyong*/ khong gi gdul bya dus la babs pa yin/ bdag gi snying tig gi bstan pa ni/ snying tig snga 'gyur 'chal te nub tu nye ba'i dus na bstan pa nub khar gsal te/ rgyas la dar drags pa yun thung bar 'gyur/ dus kyi tha ma mi lo lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus su lha lcam 'di mi lus len/ de mnga' bdag gi sprul pas rjes su 'dzin/ mnga' bdag skye ba mtha' ma'i dus su chos 'brel thogs pa tsam yin/ skye ba de'i phyi ma la snying tig man ngag gi gter dang 'phrad/ de'i dus su 'gro don mi 'byung nyams su len pa'i dus yin/ tshe tshad lnga bcu nga dgu bzhugs/ las dag ldan pa dang mi ldan pa'i 'brel pa kha yar 'ong*/ de rnams la la bde ba can du 'gro ste khong gi gdul byar 'gyur/ la la ngan song du skye/ de nas dam sel gyis gshegs tshul ston te/ lnga bcu'i gong du 'da' yang srid/ dam sel la 'dzem la bshags pa la 'bungs/ de ltar byas na dgung lo tshad du bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su ḍāk+ki sde lngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bud med cig 'byung srid de/ de'i gdul bya yin no/ /de byung na des phyag rgya ma byas nas tshe la gsos thebs na lnga bcu las mi tshad pa yang bzhugs srid do/ /gdul bya las ldan gyi bu de sha sme'i rtags can zhig 'ongs bas/ de la gdams pa ma lus pa byin na 'gro don yang bag tsam zhig nus so/ de la ma byung na phyi ma'i gdul byar 'ong nges te kha rag gi phur lhag med 'tshang rgya'o/ /gdams pa 'di rnams bum thang smad du ma 'khyol na sngar gyi gter shul lam lha 'dre mi 'pho ba'i brag la sbas na skye ba phyi ma la thon par 'gyur ro/

/skye ba 'di 'das nas longs sku'i zhing khams dar gcig nyul lo/ /de nas bum thang thar pa gling du skye/ bco lnga lon nas 'gro don byed/ gter sgo mang bar 'byed/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston te dgung lo bcu bdun bzhugs/ bud med ky-i lus bzung ba'i ḍāk+ki sde lngas yum byas te 'gro don 'ur ba 'byung*/ sras zla ba grags pa bya ba rta mgrin gyi sprul pa gcig 'khrungs/ des kyang 'gro don byed de bstan pa mi lo dgu bcu skyong ngo*/ /de'i chos skal yin pas gter du sbed/ ces gsungs nas bum thang seng ge'i brag phug tu rgyud bco brgyad kyi glegs bam sbas te bzhugs so/ /rgyud de rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu gnad kyi man ngag tu dril ba/ ku su la'i skor zab pa las ches zab pa 'di rnams dwags po dang lung gi khra mo brag la gter tu sbas nas ldang lha la gter bdag bcol te/ 'di'i chos skor gyi grangs la/ btags grol gyi rgyud drug dang*/ de'i 'grel pa drug pa dang*/ lo rgyus dang*/ rtsal dbang dang*/ rgyud kyi bcang thabs dang*/ gzhan don rtag sa bstan dang*/ yon tan dang 'byung tshul lam che ba/ 'das rjes gsum dang*/ btag grol don khrid dang nyi shu rtsa gsum po de btags grol gyi skor ro/ / yang rigs lnga phyi sgrub dang nang sgrub dang*/ spros bcas bum dbang dang*/ ḍāk+ki mngon rtogs dang*/ dbang gsum pa dang*/ gsum pa'i lag len dang*/ dbang gi rgyab yig dang*/ khyad par gyi dbang lnga dang*/ phyi sgrub nang sgrub kyi las byang thun mong dang*/ gsang sgrub kyi las byang rtsar 'phreng dang*/ dbang sgrub dang*/ bum sgrub dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag dang*/ phyi nang gi tshogs mchod dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ gsang sgrub kyi tshogs mchod dang*/ dbang gsum tho yig dang*/ gsang dbang gi lhan thabs dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi lhan thabs dang*/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi man ngag dang*/ spyi gnad dang*/

bla rdo dang*/ ḍāk+ki'i nor sgrub dang*/ nyi shu rtsa gsum po de dbang dang*/ lag len gyi chos skor ro/ /yang thod rgal don khrid nor bu'i snying po dang*/ de'i ti ka gsal byed sgron ma dang*/ khrid rgyab lung gi phreng ba dang*/ brtags yig dang*/ tshad yig dang*/ lnga po de khrid kyi skor ro/ /de dag gi rgyab chos su/ snying tig chen mo dang*/ don gsal me long dang*/ ngo sprod lam 'bras dang*/ zhal gdams gnad thigs dang*/ rdo rje chu 'thung dang*/ dgu po de rgyab chos kyi skor ro/ /yang zhi ba bar do lam gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro bo bar do dang*/ bar do'i zhal gdams gnyis dang*/ bar do bzhi'i bskul rkyen gyi man ngag dang*/ lnga po de bar do'i gdams skor ro/ /yang lto gos kyi zhen pa gcod pa la rdel 'cha' dang*/ gtum mo gnyis dang*/ lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba la bka' srung srog sgrub nag mo'i rgyud dang*/ gdams pa dang rgyu dus thun drug /bla rdo/ cho 'phrul/ man ngag la sogs te cha lag gi skor ro/ /de yang btags grol rgyud drug la ni/ kun tu bzang po nas o rgyan pad+ma'i bar du dgongs par brgyud nas/ slob dpon gyis gsungs shing mtsho rgyal gyis bsdus nas 'grel pa drug po mkhar chen mas mdzad do/ /btags grol snying po'i don khrid ni 'ga' rab rdo rjes mdzad nas shrī sing has 'das rjes dang bcas pa slob dpon pad+ma la gsungs so/ /de las gzhan pa'i man ngag rgyud bco brgyad kyi dgongs pa bzhin du g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu slob dpon pad+mas mdzad la/ khrid kyi lag len ti ka don khrid ni mkhar chen mas mdzad do/ /mkha' 'gro zhus len ni gol sa dang the tshom bcad pa'i phyir mtsho rgyal gyis slob dpon la zhus nas yi ger btab bo/ /bstan srung srog sgrub nag mo'i rgyud gdams pa dang bcas pa ni sha za'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rdo rje gdan gyi byang du dbang phyug chen po'i rten gyi nang du sbas pa mu stegs gu ya shrīs bton no/

/de la slob dpon pad+mas gser srang stong phul nas zhus te/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi bka' srung du bskos so/ /dkar chag them du ma thebs pa'i gter kha lhan cig nas byung ba ni/ tshe sgrub gcig / dzam nag lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi lo rgyus dang them yig rnams byung ngo*/ / chos skor 'di rnams slob dpon pad+ma yab yum gyis khra mo brag tu sbas pa la/ dus phyis 'bri la ldang chos 'byung du sku 'khrungs pa'i lha lcam pad+ma gsal sku skye bzhes pa/ brla g.yas pa'i nang na sha mtshan mkha' 'gro ma'i spyan 'dra ba yod pa/ khams chu/ dgung snying yos bu/ mtshan tshul rdor zhes bya ba/ sbyangs pa'i las sad pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems su rtogs pa des/ gzhi bdag dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa dang*/ kha byang lde mig kyang lag tu byon nas chu mo glang gi lo/ ston zla tha chung gi nyi shu bdun gyi nyin/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag rnams la tshogs mchod phul nas gsol ba btab ste gter nas gdan drangs so/ /gter g.yog rnams lo ston rdo rje 'bum gyis byas so/ /de nas rin po che tshul rdor ni/ gu ru rin po ches lung bstan pa las/ chos 'di rnams gsang zhing nyams su blangs te gter dpe rnams sngar gyi gter shul lam/ bum thang ngam/ lha 'dre mi 'pho ba'i brag la sbas na skye ba phyi ma la thon nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ de ltar ma byas na dam sel gyis sku tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa las/ lung bstan phyi ma'i dbang du gyur nas gshegs so/ /shog ser rnams lo ston rdo rje 'bum gyi phyag na yod pas/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes zhus so/ /lcags mo lug gi lo bre'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la kong po tsā ri gsar rnying gi mtshams/ la rgyab kyi ri khrod du kha rag pa grags pa dbang phyug la sogs pas shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /mkha' 'gro zhus len gyi shog ser rtse sor gsum la yig phreng nyi shu rtsa gnyis re byas pa cig gzhan yid ches pa'i phyir chos rje pas bsnams nas byon no/

/rmongs pa la la dag gter ma la dbang bka' chad par 'gyur ro snyam du dogs na/ slob dpon pad+mas bzhed pa 'di ltar gsungs so/ /shog ser mthong bas slob dpon pad+ma'i sku dang mjal/ brda 'phrad pas gsung dang mjal/ don 'phrad pas thugs dang mjal lo/ /mdor na chos rnams la brgyud tshul drug yod pa 'di gang rung cig dang ldan na brgyud pa ma chad par 'gyur te/ drug gang zhe na/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa dang*/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa dang*/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa dang*/ thugs rje byin rlabs brgyud pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa dang*/ smon lam dbang gi brgyud pa'o/ /de dag las/ 'di la drug kha tshang ste/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rigs lngas rang bzhin du snod la dgongs pa tsam gyis rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ de bzhin du bdag 'dra pad+mas kyang ma 'ongs par 'gro ba la dgongs nas zab gter dbang bka' dang bcas pa sbas pas/ su yis thon pa la dgongs brgyud kyi dbang bka' yod do zhes bzhed do/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyang 'di la tshang ste/ kun tu bzang po nas rigs lnga'i bar du brgyud pa thams cad brda'i phyag rgya bstan pa tsam gyis dbang thob la/ bdag 'dra pad+mas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i snod ldan la dbang bskur ba 'di ltar gyis shig ces pa'i gter dpe bzhag ste/ slob bus de bzhin du dbang bskur bas byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob pa'i phyir dbang bka' yod do zhes bzhed do/ /rig pa bdun pa'i rgyud las/ brda dang brdas mtshon go ba ni/ /dbang gi nang nas dbang bka' 'o/ /zhes so/ /snyan khung du brgyud tshul yang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sprul sku yi ge'i gzugs su 'byung bar mdo du ma nas gsungs la/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo las/ ri dang rde 'u shing bu dang*/ /rnga bo che dang dpag bsam shing*/ /de dag las ni sgra 'byung ba/ /rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/

/'di dag bka' zhes bya bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs shing*/ slob dpon pad+mas bzhed pa'i/ gter dpe bzhin ma nor bar nyams su blangs bas/ bla ma dag sangs rgyas dang*/ rang sems dbyer med du gyur pa'i snyan brgyud dam par bzhed de/ gter lung las/ chos sku kun tu bzang po la/ /bla ma bya ba yod min te/ /dbang bskur chos bshad byed mkhan med/ / rang sems chos skur shes tsa na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang lung thob/ / brgyud par 'dzin pa rtog pa yin/ /zhes so/ /thugs rje byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa yang 'di la tshang ste/ kun tu bzang po nas rim pa bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa tsam la/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob la/ bdag 'dra pad+mas kyang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i don du zab gter sbas pa de sus thon pa dang mthong ba la byin rlabs zhugs te/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob po zhes bshad do/ /mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa yang 'di la tshang ste/ kun tu bzang po nas rim bzhin du skal ldan dang ma phrad kyi bar du mkha' 'gro ma la gtad nas/ gter srung rnams kyis snod ldan la gtod pa'i lung thob pa yin no/ /zhes bshad do/ / smon lam dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa yang 'di la tshang ste/ thams cad smon lam gyis mtha' sgyur ba las smon lam ni sangs rgyas kyi bden pa'i bka' yin la/ bka' ni mi bslu ba'i mchog dam pa yin te/ bdag 'dra pad+mas kyang ma 'ongs las can cig dang phrad par shog ces smon lam btab pas/ de'i mthu yis las can cig dang 'phrad pa yin te/ dbang thams cad kyi dam pa smon lam yin no zhes bzhed do/ /mdor na slob dpon pad+mas bzhed pa'i shog ser mthong ba tsam zhal mthong gi 'khor yin la dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par longs pa ni thugs kyi sras te/ dbang thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bzhed do/ /de ltar brgyud pa drug dang ldan par dbang lung dpe rnams rje rin po che'i drung du byon pa yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa ni chos rje rang byung rdo rje nyid sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang dngos su mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs tshul dang chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba'i tshul du ma rnam thar tshigs bcad mar lta'o/

/chos 'di'i khyad par gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje rin po ches jo mo gangs la dben pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas mdun gyi nam mkha' la gsal bar snang zhing*/ dngos su dbang bskur/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba dang*/ jo mo kha rag gi shar phyogs kyi ri khrod du dben pa mdzad pa'i ston zla ra ba'i nya'i dus tshigs la mnal lam du gu rus byin brlabs dbang bskur mdzad do/ /yang snying pad+ma phug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus mkha' 'gro mas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag snang la mgur mang po gsungs shing*/ slob dpon pad+ma'i gdams pa sngar mjal ba rnams kyi mthar thug tu gyur pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa zha

ི ga dang myur du mjal lo snyam thugs kyis dgongs pa las/ ring por ma thogs par slob dpon pad+ma yab yum gyis rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang bla na med pa ku su li 'i skor rnams dwags po dang lung khra mo brag la sbas pa'i gter/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi skye ba sbas pa'i rnal 'byor tshul rdor gyis bton nas khong gi gter g.yog pa lo ston rdo rje 'bum la gnang ba de la ོ ston gyis chos rje'i drung du dbul lo/ /rin po che dgyes shing*/ sngar gu ru dang mkha' 'gros dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa'i don mngon du gyur te/ chos rje rin po ches rjes su bzung nas chu pho spre'u'i lo zla ba dang po la mtshur phu bde chen gyi dben gnas su nye gnas chen po slob dpon ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ 'brong ru ba mkhan po rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan ye rgyal/ sprul sku dbon po sman lung pa/ bdag g.yung ston smyon pa dang lnga la bka'i gnyer gtad cing*/ gzhan yang mchod g.yog pa dang*/ gsol ja ba la sogs pa bdun tsam dang bcas pa la dbang lnga yongs su rdzogs par bskur nas gdams pa thams cad lhag ma med par gnang ngo*/ /lo rgyus 'di dang dbang lnga'i dbang byang phyag len lhan thabs su bsgrigs pa 'di dang*/ mkha' 'gro phyi nang gi las byang dang*/ gsang sgrub rta phag zhal sbyor gyi las byang bstod pa dang bcas pa 'di rnams slob dpon pad+ma'i yig cha rnams dang*/ chos rje pa'i gsung bzhin lag tu blang bde bar khrigs su bkod pa 'di shākya'i dge slong rdo rje dpal bzang pos bkod pa yin mod kyi/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ mchod 'bul/ tshogs mchod kyi yig cha rnams su gung sgrig na 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mkha' klong yangs pa nas/ /yang gsang snying tig nyin mor byed par byas/ /mngon sum rang gnad tsha zer phyogs bcur rgyas/ /brgyud pa gsum gyis ma rig mun pas sangs/

/bdag blo chu skyes zum pa cung zad bye/ /nyams myong rtogs pa'i ge sar rab 'phel nas/ / yang zab gnad kyi man ngag dri bsung gis/ /rjes 'jug las can bung ba'i tshogs tshim zhing*/ /yid dpyod 'dzin pa'i gar sby-i+in dang bral ngang*/ /mngon sum rig pa'i 'dab gshog rab 'phel te/ /chos nyid zad pa'i nam mkhar gar byed cing*/ /bdag med chos kyi sgra skad kun sgrogs shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /dge'o/ /maṅga lam// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6) lo rgyus rgyal ba g.yung gis mdzad pa/ - PAGE 152 -- PAGE 153 -- PAGE 142 -
